responses.answer:
并非须立即重启。惟验证通过后，方建议重启。此为建议，并非强制，亦非禁止重启。

超时不足以断定操作失败。若未收到响应，须先查操作状态。若状态未确认操作失败，则不得重试。

给模型的英文指令：

It is not mandatory to do a restart immediately. A restart is recommended only after validation gives satisfactory results.

A timeout can occur without operation failure.

If you receive no response, first examine the operation status.
If the operation status does not show operation failure, do not do the operation again.
